oneOf.description: macOS universal binary, or a Windows bundle carrying both.

Confidence.description: How sure a scanner is that an item belongs to its product.

oneOf.description: Guessed from a file or folder name.
From a version resource or bundle plist.
From a stable identifier: VST3 class ID, AU type/subtype/manufacturer, CLAP ID.

ContentHash.description: A BLAKE3 hash of a user-owned file, written `blake3:<64 hex chars>`.

Item.description:
One thing installed on a machine: a plug-in binary in one format, a vendor
app, a template, a folder. Metadata only.

content_hash.description: Only for user-owned files that may sync. Plug-ins and libraries are never hashed.

platform_portable.description: True when the same file works on every OS (JSFX, Reaper themes, most presets).

product_id.description: `None` until identity resolution places the item.

size.description: Bytes on disk; for bundles and folders, the total.

version.description: The version string exactly as the vendor wrote it. Compared in `patchpilot-parity`.

ItemKind.description: What kind of thing an [`Item`] is.

oneOf.description: A DAW template, rack, preset, script, theme or project.
iLok License Manager, PACE and similar. Detected, never authenticated.

id.description: Stable random ID, generated once per install. Not derived from hardware.

name.description: User-chosen name, e.g. "Studio PC" or "Travel MacBook".

path_map.description: How this machine's logical roots map to folders.

Os.description: Operating system of a machine or item.

PathMap.description:
Maps logical roots to physical folders on one machine.

Works on path strings rather than `std::path::Path` so a Windows map can be
built and tested on macOS and vice versa.

roots.description: Logical root name to physical folder, as the OS spells it.

PortablePath.description:
A path as stored in a manifest.

Prefer [`PortablePath::Logical`]: a named root such as `SAMPLES_ROOT` plus a
`/`-separated relative path, resolved per machine through a [`PathMap`].
[`PortablePath::Absolute`] is the fallback for paths outside every root, and
is only meaningful on the machine that wrote it.

rel.description: Path below the root, `/`-separated on every OS. Empty for the root itself.

oneOf.description: A machine-specific absolute path, as the OS spells it.

Product.description: A product as the user thinks of it ("FabFilter Pro-Q 4"), across formats and OSes.

ProductId.description:
Canonical product identifier, shared by every format and OS of one product.

Stable once assigned; identity resolution (in `patchpilot-parity`) decides
which items share one.

description: Everything one machine has, at one point in time.

generated_at.description: When the scan finished, Unix seconds UTC.

schema_version.description: Always [`MANIFEST_SCHEMA_VERSION`] when written by this build.
